# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen to nineteen years old during her first two years at Redmond College.  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 c19 P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Jonas Blake  <sub>[v3 c27 P18](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is a very pretty girl with an irregular, bewitching type of beauty. She has a rose-red, crooked mouth, brown velvet eyes with oddly-pointed black brows, satin-smooth hair, and a soft, ripe glow on her round cheeks. She dresses in a very stylish, fashionable manner, and possesses an airy, graceful figure.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005)_

## Personality

Philippa is an irrepressibly gay, flighty, and chatterbox young woman who claims to be utterly afflicted with indecision. She is intensely fond of fun and social popularity, admitting that she loves having crowds of admirers around her. Beneath her surface frivolity, she is a deeply loyal, warm-hearted friend without a trace of snobbishness or envy. Though she often light-heartedly mocks her own lack of seriousness, she possesses a genuine, womanly soul and a keen intellect.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019)_

## History

Philippa Gordon first met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant in Old St. John's Cemetery during their first week as Freshmen at Redmond College. Suffering from acute homesickness, she quickly struck up a close friendship with the two girls. Through her high social standing and radiant charm, she introduced them into Redmond's active social life. Initially, Philippa was torn between two home suitors, Alec and Alonzo, unable to decide between them. During her second year at college, she joined Anne, Priscilla, and Stella Maynard in renting Patty's Place to keep house together under the care of Aunt Jamesina. While vacationing at Prospect Point, she met Jonas Blake, a poor theological student. She fell deeply in love with him, discarded her former wealth-oriented ambitions, and eventually became engaged to him in her Junior year, resolving to support his work as a minister.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P52](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0052), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P18](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0018)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to a wealthy and exclusive Bluenose family  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- Attended Redmond College in Kingsport to oblige her father rather than settle down immediately into marriage  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048)</sub>
